title: The Great Gatsby Soirée
subtitle: West Egg Champagne Gala & Speakeasy Soirée
description: Step into Jay Gatsby's glittering ballroom draped in gilded decadence, jazz rhythms, and sparkling crystal chandeliers. Transform your portrait into a radiant 1920s high-society masterpiece illuminated with champagne shimmer and flapper glamour.

waitingExperience.title: Conjuring Gatsby's Grandeur...
waitingExperience.subtitle: Imbuing your portrait with 1920s champagne luminescence & haute couture

sequence.text: Checking the speakeasy guest list & welcoming you to West Egg...
Tailoring velvet tuxedos, silk headbands, and pearl necklaces...
Igniting golden sparklers and swirling vintage crystal chandeliers...
Pouring vintage Dom Pérignon champagne and balancing warm sepia tones...
Finishing touches complete! Unveiling your Roaring Twenties portrait...

waitingExperience.completionMessage: A Toast to You, Old Sport!
